record.field: Website: https://myfaizy.com WhatsApp: +92 334 2726048 (the only WhatsApp number to write) Facebook: FaizyHaiNa Tagline: Simplifying Life Across Borders. Customers are overseas Pakistanis with family in Pakistan; agents work in Karachi. Faizy handles everyday assistance tasks directly. Repairs and skilled trade work are done by verified experts that Faizy coordinates and supervises; a Faizy representative is never described or shown doing the repair.

Nothing is sent, posted or changed without a person's approval. Customer messages go out only 10:00 to 21:00 Karachi time, every day. Never invent services, prices, plans, statistics, testimonials or contact details. If a fact is not in these notes or the order record, say it needs checking. Medical tasks are logistics only. Never give medical advice. An emergency goes to a person immediately. An order is not done without photo proof and an itemised receipt. Completing or cancelling an order, refunds and price changes are done by people. Urdu drafts are read by Mashood before approval.
